text:
Alex Kim: Heads up — running into weird 400s on /rerank when shipping embeddings from the JS SDK. Works in Python. Anyone else?

Morgan Patel: Seen something similar — dim mismatch alert? can you paste curl + payload?

Alex Kim: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"find best docs","candidates":[{"id":"a","embedding":"[0.01,0.02,...(1536 values)...]"}] }'
```
Error we get: {"error":"vector_dim_mismatch","expected":1024,"got":1536}

Vivian Chen: Yup that's an SDK parity issue — our JS client currently returns embeddings from the browser model pipeline (1536) while the rerank model alias expects 1024. Python helper was silently truncating. We shouldn't rely on silent fixes.

Samir Rao: Also saw retry differences — JS retries on 401 during token refresh which caused duplicate requests in a few cases. Python has an auth-refresh hook that dedupes in-flight refreshes.

Vivian Chen: Plan: add SDK-level validation for embedding dims + optional auto-truncate flag for sample apps, and align retry/auth behavior. I'll open DE-289.

DevEx Bot: Created ticket DE-289: "js-sdk: embedding dim check + retry policy parity" — assigned to @Vivian Chen :spiral_note_pad:

Vivian Chen: Example helper I'm prototyping (JS):
```js
function validateEmbeddings(embs, expected){
  if (!Array.isArray(embs)) throw new Error('embeddings must be an array');
  if (embs.length === expected) return embs;
  if (embs.length > expected) return embs.slice(0, expected);
  throw new Error(`Expected embedding length ${expected}, got ${embs.length}`);
}
```

Morgan Patel: For onboarding, sample app should show clear error: "Expected embedding length X; got Y. Use model 'embed-1024' or regenerate embeddings." That would've saved hours for some customers.

Alex Kim: Temporary patch in our app: `ensureDim` wrapper that truncates or throws. Works but we need it in SDK.

Vivian Chen: I'll push PR with tests + update sample-apps/rerank to run dim checks during dev builds. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Morgan Patel: :thumbsup: Also add a small CLI check for batch payloads — rejects bad batches early.

Alex Kim: FYI streaming rerank shapes differ: Python yields `[{score, item}]`, JS currently returns `{items: [...]}`. Would be great to standardize.

Vivian Chen: Noted — adding response-shape parity to DE-289 follow-up. Will update docs and examples.

Samir Rao: Repro gist (private): https://gist.github.com/fake/repro-emb-dim — includes curl + node snippet.

Alex Kim: Thanks everyone — saving the ticket and temp helper to our sample app until SDK lands.
